brand_identity.name: NeuroClaim Support
brand_identity.mission: Empowering injured workers with TBI to navigate WCB claims with clarity, calm, and confidence.
design_principles: Cognitive Clarity: One task at a time. No clutter.
Sensory Safety: Low glare, warm tones, no flashing.
Human Warmth: Soft shapes, empathetic language.
Accessible by Default: Large text, high contrast, clear navigation.

typography.rules: Avoid pure black text on pure white. Use Stone-900 on Stone-50 for light mode. Use Stone-100 on Stone-900 for dark mode.

layout_strategies.dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 md:p-8

components_customization.buttons: h-12 px-6 rounded-full text-base font-medium transition-all hover:scale-[1.02]
components_customization.inputs: h-12 rounded-lg border-2 border-input focus:border-primary text-lg px-4 bg-background
components_customization.cards: rounded-2xl border-none shadow-sm bg-card p-6 md:p-8

hero_background.usage: Background for Login/Register pages with 50% opacity overlay

empty_state.usage: Placeholder for empty lists or success states

community.usage: Help center or Chatbot welcome screen

motion.micro_interactions: scale-95 on active, scale-[1.02] on hover for cards

accessibility_checklist: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
All interactive elements must be focusable via keyboard.
Provide clear error messages with icons.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install fonts via index.css import.
2. THEME: Configure tailwind.config.js with the Stone color palette provided.
3. LAYOUT: Build the Dashboard using the 'Bento' Mode B but with reduced density.
4. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components in /components/ui to match the 'rounded-xl' and 'h-12' specs.
5. FEATURES: Implement the 'Focus Mode' for the Document Generator (one step at a time).
6. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs for backgrounds and empty states.
7. TESTING: Add data-testid to all inputs and buttons.

universal_guidelines.export_conventions: Named exports for components, Default exports for pages.
